specification_compliance: No findings were listed to verify. As a spot check I read the crumb logic changed by the head commit, against I8 (r6). In frontend/src/components/appshell/folderPosition.ts:65-71 a folder crumb is a link only when it is a strict ancestor of the position (position !== folder && position.startsWith(folder + '/')) and opensAnotherView holds, meaning its narrowed folders differ from both the top's folders and the currently shown folders. This matches 'strict ancestor whose view differs from the current one'.

In frontend/src/components/appshell/FolderPositionRows.tsx:61-75 the home crumb is an <a> whenever position !== null and a plain span at the top. This matches I8 r6, 'the home crumb is a link whenever the URL holds a folder', provided an invalid folder is normalised to null and replaced out of the URL (I10).
potential_unspecified_behavior: The code reads 'differs from the current one' to include 'differs from the top view'. A crumb whose narrowing equals the top's folders is not a link, even when it differs from the current view (folderPosition.ts:82). The home crumb still reaches that view, but I8's wording names only the current view.
regression_risks: opensAnotherView compares the folder arrays in order (sameFolders). If narrowFolders can return the same set in a different order, a crumb could be linked when it should not be.
